reason: Both are risk-bearing specialty commercial property and casualty insurers. They sell to businesses, earn premiums plus investment income, and are state-regulated. AFG's Specialty P&C Group offers specialized commercial coverages that help businesses manage risk (T:P1.3, T:P2.2, T:P2.3). Ategrity offers specialty E&S property and casualty coverage to small and mid-sized businesses (C:P2.4, C:P3.3, C:P1.3). AFG is larger and broader, with transportation and financial lines. Ategrity's small-business E&S focus sits inside AFG's specialty casualty and property markets, so the overlap is direct.
